flags.summary: An Arcana check unpicked the binding on the abbey garden's stitched scarecrows (abbey_of_st_markovia_garden, check scarecrows_unbind): their fight (garden_sentry) doesn't start.
A search of the study's hearth (Investigation or Perception, court_hearth_grate) found the iron plate and the passage behind the fire. Not the way to the treasury itself, which is the portrait.
The study's fire is out (waited out, doused, or beaten out with a cloak). The passage behind the hearth and the smokestack's climb no longer burn.
Someone climbed down the keep roof's smokestack (spires_smokestack): the way down to the study's hearth is open.
Someone lifted a goat cheese at Krezk (lift_a_cheese) and found the stair of cheeses behind the board. Read by Watchman Lazar's wall_watch line.
Someone dug up the pedlar's first tin in the Charcoal-Burners' Hollow (hollow_dig, needs a shovel). The first of the three the hidden Patient Spade achievement counts.
Someone looked along Blinsky's top shelf (top_shelf_look) and saw the pale puppet with no reflection; Blinsky sells it from then on.
Someone dug up the pedlar's second tin at Lake Zarovich's reedy inlet (inlet_dig, needs a shovel). The second of the three the hidden Patient Spade achievement counts.
Someone dug up the pedlar's last tin on the Berez marsh track (marsh_dig, needs a shovel). The third of the three the hidden Patient Spade achievement counts.
Someone lifted the furs on the Mad Mage's bed (lift_furs) and found the hungry orb; it shows by the bed from then on.
Someone looked closely at Van Richten's jar marked DO NOT (jar_do_not). Part two of three of the hidden The Man Who Fell from the Sky achievement.
